findings.evidence_excerpt: Agent report: '14 tests'. Actual: `pytest --collect-only` -> '20 tests collected'; full run -> '20 passed in 3.27s'. Understatement (more real tests than claimed, all passing), not fabricated coverage.

findings.evidence_excerpt: Verified mutation `region_hard_won = region_pixels` (claim every region pixel won) kept all 20 tests passing because asserts use region_hard_won_count>=1 and net_target_support_delta>0. NOT a returns-markers-without-work fake: the real fakequant forward + SegNet teacher still execute (region_pixels comes from the reconstructed mask), and a harder mutation that disables fakequant enabling triggers the module's own fail-closed guard, failing 9 tests. Standard threshold-vs-exact-value tradeoff; reverted via git checkout.
findings.title: Survival behavioral tests pin thresholds (>=1, net>0) not exact re-measured pixel counts

findings.evidence_excerpt: `grep -c 'def test_' test_birth_survival.py` = 20; pytest -v shows 20 PASSED 0 SKIPPED (MLX installed). The deliverable is stronger than reported; understatement is benign, not a fabrication.

findings.evidence_excerpt: _survival_row does `dict(worst_region)` (line 1026); adversarial poison probe showed forbidden keys in input worst_region DO appear in the row dict. However: (a) the real receipt's worst_region (from RegionDebt.as_dict()) carries only structural keys; (b) the actual custody surface `_validate_substrate_artifact_metadata` (long_training_canonical.py:339) recursively rejects nested forbidden keys at ANY depth - verified it raised ValueError on a poisoned nested 'promotable'. Not an exploitable custody violation.
findings.title: worst_region copied verbatim into survival row (defended-in-depth at custody boundary)

findings.evidence_excerpt: In the smoke fixture the REAL region_hard_won_count already equals region_pixel_count (48==48), so mutating `region_hard_won = int(stats['region_hard_won_pixels'])` -> `region_hard_won = region_pixels` left all 14 tests green. Probe output: 'REAL region_hard_won_count = 48 / REAL region_pixel_count = 48 / MUTATION-WOULD-BE-NOOP? True'. This is NOT test-blindness: a monkeypatch forcing region_hard_won=0 yields survived=False and WOULD FAIL test_fakequant_survival_row_carries_live_action_id_and_real_survived (probe: 'FAIL survived is True / FAIL region_hard_won_count >= 1'), proving survived flows from re-measurement. A sibling follow-up already added test_region_support_counts_only_forward_me
findings.title: region_hard_won=region_pixels mutation is a fixture-coincidence no-op (suite cannot catch THIS specific override via the original 14 tests, though it is not a real fake)

findings.evidence_excerpt: During revert/mutation cycling I once saw `assert payload['composite_accepted'] is True -> assert False is True` at line 975. Could NOT reproduce: headline test 40/40 PASS isolated, whole-file 6/6 PASS, failing-triplet 10/10 PASS, all against clean committed code (40x stress: 'PASS=40 FAIL=0 / 40'). Most likely MLX Metal state contamination from an adjacent in-flight mutated-code process; not a defect in the committed code.
findings.title: Single non-reproducible transient headline-test failure observed during mutation churn

findings.evidence_excerpt: In isolation the tests are fully deterministic: HEAD file-alone 0/15 flakes, parent file-alone 0/15, grouped flaky-candidates 0/15, full hi_nerv dir 0/12 (`HEAD-DIR TOTAL FLAKES: 0 / 12`). Sporadic 1-2 (and one anomalous 23) failures appeared ONLY while multiple MLX/pytest processes ran in parallel in the background - a known Metal GPU FP/concurrency artifact. The composite-admit margin is large (composite_delta_score_nonrate ~= -99.999, not borderline). RNG-perturbation probe showed identical admit outcome to 14 digits, ruling out RNG-state leakage. Not a tests-verify-constants or fragile-test defect; CLAUDE.md deterministic-reproducibility holds in isolation.
findings.title: Behavioral MLX composite tests show intermittent non-determinism only under concurrent Metal/MLX process load
